 Jess Anderson, Charlotte Coates and Sam Drury
 Show Most recent Most popular CLOSE! published at 14:15 GMT 14:15 GMT 
 Liverpool 0-0 Brighton 
 Brighton carve Liverpool open as Diego Gomez plays the ball behind Virgil van Dijk for Pascal Gross to chase. His cut back is perfect for Yasin Ayari to strike but he lifts it over the top. 
 Should be 1-0, really. 
 27 37 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Bournemouth look a threat' published at 14:14 GMT 14:14 GMT 
 Man Utd 0-0 Bournemouth 
 Clinton Morrison 
Former Crystal Palace striker on BBC Radio 5 Live 
 It's been what I've expected the game to look like. 
 One thing I will say is the fans are behind United. There have been many times I've come to Old Trafford when they don't start well and the fans are a bit quiet. 
 But it's been a good start - in particular for Bournemouth, they look a threat from Rayan on that right-hand side. 
 75 39 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 14:13 GMT 14:13 GMT 
 Man Utd 0-0 Bournemouth 
 Marcus Tavernier scampers down the left-hand side and squares across for Evanilson but the Brazilian can't get the ball under control.
 The Cherries look better than their six Premier League points would suggest.
 90 28 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 14:11 GMT 14:11 GMT 
 Liverpool 0-0 Brighton 
 Charlie Adam 
Former Liverpool midfielder on BBC Radio 5 Live extra 
 That was good play from Barcola, doing his bit from all the way at the other of the pitch and it is exactly what you need to do under Iraola. 
 239 45 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 14:11 GMT 14:11 GMT 
 Man Utd 0-0 Bournemouth 
 Clinton Morrison 
Former Crystal Palace striker on BBC Radio 5 Live 
 United are at their most vulnerable when they're attacking and Bournemouth counter-attack well. 
 122 52 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 14:11 GMT 14:11 GMT 
 Man Utd 0-0 Bournemouth 
 Image source, Getty Images I think it's fair to say Manchester United have not got going here.
 It all looks a bit pedestrian so far.
 158 60 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 A real test for Costinha published at 14:11 GMT 14:11 GMT 
 Liverpool 0-0 Brighton 
 Aadam Patel 
Football Reporter at Anfield 
 This will be a real test for Joao Costinha. He's come on in all of Brighton's Premier League games so far but never this early. 
 It's Cody Gakpo who is attacking down that left flank for Liverpool for now but you wouldn't be surprised to see either Bradley Barcola or Rio Ngumoha down that side later on too. Either way, Costinha will have his work cut out.
 81 18 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 14:11 GMT 14:11 GMT 
 Liverpool 0-0 Brighton 
 Alisson gathers and launches one upfield for Alexander Isak but Luka Vuskovic watches it all the way before heading back to Bart Verbruggen. 
 Must've been swirling all over the shop in this wind. 
 57 17 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Get Involved published at 14:09 GMT 14:09 GMT 
 Click 'Get Involved' to have your say 
 Well, United haven’t conceded in the first two minutes, so things are looking up!
 James 
 658 98 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 CLOSE! published at 14:09 GMT 14:09 GMT 
 Man Utd 0-0 Bournemouth 
 Diogo Dalot breaks free down the left and lifts the cross in but it's punched away by Djordje Petrovic.
 Bournemouth get up the other end at pace and it's a glorious opportunity after they carve through Manchester United.
 Rayan sends the ball in and it would have been a tap in for Evanilson had Leny Yoro not got their first with an important intervention.
 Corner to the Cherries.
 25 11 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Newcastle fans 1-0 Storm Boelo published at 14:08 GMT 14:08 GMT 
 Crystal Palace 0-0 Newcastle 
 Neil Johnston 
BBC Sport football reporter at Selhurst Park 
 They've had to overcome awful conditions to get here but the Toon Army have turned up in numbers in South London to support their team. Another outstanding effort by Newcastle's fans.
 542 129 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Gloves update published at 14:08 GMT 14:08 GMT 
 Liverpool 0-0 Brighton 
 Aadam Patel 
Football Reporter at Anfield 
 An early update to say that excluding the goalkeepers, three of Liverpool's players have got gloves on. None for Brighton.
 The three are Jeremy Jacquet, Milos Kerkez and Bradley Barcola. Winter is here.
 128 155 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 SUBSTITUTION published at 14:08 GMT 14:08 GMT 
 Liverpool 0-0 Brighton 
 Image source, Getty Images An early change for Brighton as Ferdi Kadioglu can't carry on. He's replaced by Costinha. 
 75 96 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 14:07 GMT 14:07 GMT 
 Crystal Palace 0-0 Newcastle 
 Palace have started this one really well after that 5-0 drubbing at Brighton last week. 
 Dwight McNeil moves through the pitch really well and Daichi Kamada drags wide. 
 84 48 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Man Utd ownership in the line of fire published at 14:07 GMT 14:07 GMT 
 Man Utd 0-0 Bournemouth 
 Simon Stone 
BBC Sport Chief Football News Reporter at Old Trafford 
 There is a lot of blame being scattered about for Manchester United's present plight but there is no doubt who the club's supporters hold responsible.
 Inside the first minute there were songs against the Glazer family and Sir Jim Ratcliffe.
 They were followed by one supporting Michael Carrick.
 However today turns out, the way the club is funded and the decisions that have been taken around it have cost United money and also a lot of goodwill.
 236 31 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 14:07 GMT 14:07 GMT 
 Man Utd 0-0 Bournemouth 
 A crucial piece of defending from Harry Maguire and he gets a few slaps on the back from his team-mates for that.
 It does result in a corner, though, but Senne Lammens claims.
 Bournemouth have started the brighter at Old Trafford.
 86 36 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 14:06 GMT 14:06 GMT 
 Liverpool 0-0 Brighton 
 Ryan Gravenberch is picking up where he left off before he was sent for an early bath against Man City as he glides through the midfield and causes problems for Brighton. 
 230 36 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 14:06 GMT 14:06 GMT 
 Hull 0-0 Brentford 
 Hull win an early corner and it's played short before being whipped into the box then headed behind for another corner.
 It's a similar set-piece routine but this time Brentford push the Tigers right back into their own half.
 22 11 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 14:05 GMT 14:05 GMT 
 Man Utd 0-0 Bournemouth 
 A decent delivery to the back stick and Rayan gets to the header before Carlos Baleba but nods wide.
 71 45 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 14:04 GMT 14:04 GMT 
 Liverpool 0-0 Brighton 
 Not the bright start to the game we'd have wanted at Anfield as Ferdi Kadioglu goes down and needs treatment on a sore back. 
 He looks in a fair bit of pain here.
